ns2:course.label: Advanced Grammar in Context
ns2:course.description: Advanced practical study of present-day French, with an emphasis on grammar, free composition and a consideration of various cultural contexts of language use. Credit is not given for FR 314 and FR 414. Prerequisite: FR 207.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for FR 314 and FR 414. Prerequisite: FR 207.
